title: A Name from a Far-off Land

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The crew find themselves searching all
over the beach for Maho's missing plushies.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海水浴場からぬいぐるみたちがいなくなり、
【自警団（カォン）】のメンバーたちは海辺を探す。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I checked from end to end,
but they're definitely not here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
浜辺の端から端まで走ってきたけど、
ぬいぐるみは見当たらなかったさ～！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Our other belongings are fine, so it's hard to believe anyone stole them.
Especially when you consider just how many there were.
It'd be way too obvious.
text_block_list.orig_text:
泥棒ってのも考えにくいよな。
あたしらの荷物は無事だったし、
なにより、
あれだけの数のぬいぐるみを盗むのは目立ちすぎる。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You'd have a better chance convincing me
that they just up and went off somewhere on their own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぬいぐるみが自分から動き出して
どっか行っちまった、
って方が
まだありえそうだぜ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
On their own...?
Did they... did they all come to hate me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分から……
みんな……
うちのこと、
嫌いになってしもたんやろか。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Makoto!
text_block_list.orig_text: マコト！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry! That didn't come out the way I meant it to!
Look. There's no way they'd hate you when you always treat them so well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご、
ごめん姫さん！
　そういうつもりじゃなかったんだ！
そもそも
あれだけ大切にされてたのに、
ぬいぐるみたちが嫌いになるわけねぇだろ！？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine.
If they left on their own, then they'll be back at some point.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
ええんよ。
自分たちで出て行ったなら、
きっと戻ってきてくれはりますって。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let's have ourselves some lunch.
It'd be a real waste to spend our time off worrying now, wouldn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それより、
お昼にしましょ。
せっかくの休暇なんやから、
のんびりせなあかんよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Maho...
text_block_list.orig_text: マホ……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Princess...
text_block_list.orig_text: 姫さん……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: My prince... But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はん……
でも。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come to think of it, I saw a fishing village while I was out swimming!
We might find some clues there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
そういえば、
泳いでるとき近くに漁村が見えたさ～！
そこになら手掛かりがあるかもね～

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I know for a fact that Kasumi would suggest we
ask around town if she were here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カスミならこういうとき、
まずは聞き込みからだ
って言うんだろうな。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Makoto, Kaori...
Are y'all really all right with this?
choice_data_list: Why wouldn't we search for lost comrades?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトはん、
カオリはん……
ええんですの？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Thank you so much, everyone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう。
ありがとうな、
みんな……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it. We gotta fill our stomachs up first, though.
Sandwiches are quick and easy to eat,
so let's munch on some before we get to work.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気にすんなって。
そうと決まれば、
まずは腹ごしらえだ。
サンドウィッチとか手づかみで食えるし、
とにかく腹に入れとこうぜ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I [i]am[/i] super hungry, now that you mention it!
First up, we feast! Then it's investigation time! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえばお腹ペコペコだったよ～！
お腹いっぱいになったら、
調査の開始さ～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
You wouldn't think there'd be a fishing village around here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ、
こんなところに漁村があったんだな。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty bustling, too.
Is there a festival going on?
Leave the dancing to me if there is! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだかにぎやかだね～？
お祭りでもやってるのかな～？
踊りなら任せるさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
This ain't the sort of sound I'd associate with a festival.
I've got an awful bad feeling about this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お祭りにしては、
耳がひりつきますなぁ。
いやな感じがしますえ……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, let's ask that guy over there!
Hey! You got a minute?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ、
あの男に聞いてみようぜ！
なぁあんた、
ちょっといいか？

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text:
Eeek?! O-oh, it's just normal folk.
Don't scare me like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっ！？
　
な、
なんだ
人か。
脅かさないでくれよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
What was that about?
Do I really seem that threatening?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだよいきなりビビりやがって。
……そんなに怖いか？
　あたし。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Nah, not at all.
Don't sweat it. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトは怖くないよ～
元気を出すさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Apologies for approachin' ya out of the blue like that.
We were just wonderin', did somethin' happen here?
Seems like there's a mighty big commotion goin' on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いきなり話しかけて
ごめんやで、
なんや
村が騒がしいみたいやけど、
何かありましたん？

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text: ...appeared.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──が出たんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Huh? What was that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ？
　なんだって？

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text: A Majimun appeared!
text_block_list.orig_text: マジムンが出たんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
A Majimun? Never heard of that before.
Is it an animal of some sort?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジムン？
　聞いたことのない名前やねぇ？
なんかの動物やろか？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: No...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……違うさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I have.
Never expected to hear a word from my homeland here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
知ってるよ～
こんなところで
故郷の言葉を聞くとは思わなかったさ～

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's from your homeland?
That would explain the strange ring to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カオリはんの故郷の言葉なんやね。
確かに、
変わった響きやわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talking.
So what's the deal with this Majimun thing, anyway?
text_block_list.orig_text:
姫さんも大概だけどな。
で、
そのマジムンて
どういう意味なんだ？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Majimun has a special meaning back home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジムンは、
私の故郷では──

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
\"Evil spirit.\"
It's kind of like a type of yokai.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──悪霊、
妖怪を指す言葉だね～

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Didn't expect you to know that.
This village was originally formed by people who moved
from a country on the other side of the ocean.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ。
知ってるやつがいるなんて偶然だな。
この漁村はもともと、
遠い海の向こうにある国から
移住してきた人たちが作ったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text: Apparently the term Majimun originated from there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジムンってのは
そこで伝わってた言葉らしいんだが……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
That's gotta be my homeland!
Never thought I'd hear anyone talk about it here,
so I'm kind of happy. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはきっと私の故郷だね～！
故郷の話が聞けるなんて、
なんだかうれしいさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Happy?!
We're talking about e-evil spirits and yokai here!
Which means...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うれしくないだろ！？
あああ悪霊や妖怪だぞ！？
　
ってことはつまり……

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
The Majimun appeared not too long ago.
It got a number of the villagers, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうさ。
さっき
マジムンが出て、
村人が何人かやられちまった。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
It [i]got[/i] them?!
What's that supposed to mean?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やられちまったって、
どういうことだよ！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Majimun are said to steal people's souls.
There's a bunch of legends, but the most famous one is that
they'll steal your soul if they pass under your groin.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジムンは魂を奪う
って言われてるわけさ～
言い伝えは色々あるけど、
股の下をくぐられると魂を奪われる、
っていうのが有名でさ～

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Th-they steal souls?
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
魂を……？

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text:
The victim won't pass away after that,
but they're left in a sort of lethargic state, completely unable 
to move. Today's victims fit that bill.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に命を奪われたわけじゃないが、
マジムンに襲われた奴は
無気力になって
動けなくなっちまうんだ。
実際、
襲われたやつらは
みんな寝たきり状態さ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: That certainly sounds like their soul's have been stolen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
それは
魂が奪われてるみたいやねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up, Makoto?
Where's that usual stride in your walk?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～
マコト、どしたさ～？
　急に内股になってるよ～？
いつもみたいに大股で歩くさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what're you talking about? I always walk like this!
Yup, perfectly normal!
choice_data_list: You're a lot cuter than usual.
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
何のことだ？
　あたしはいつもこんな感じだぜ！？
あたしだって女の子だしな！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! As if!
You think I'd be scared of some dumb legend?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ、
はぁ！？
　そんなわけねぇだろ！
そんな言い伝えでビビるあたしじゃねぇよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hold up.
Is that your way of saying I'm usually not cute?!
Err, not that I want to be cute or anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どういう意味だおい。
まるでいつものあたしが
かわいくないみたいじゃねぇか！
いや、
かわいくなりたいわけじゃねぇけどよ……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! I ain't scared!
Hm? What's up, {0}? 
Why're you kneeling dow— Whoa?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく、
あたしは怖がってねぇからな！
ん？
　何やってんだ{0}、
体をかがめて、
なんであたしの方に……
ひゃっ！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Nothing'll be able to pass under her if she's on your shoulders.
You're so smart, {0}! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
肩車をすれば股の下はくぐられないね～
{0}は頭がいいさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Wow. Call me mighty jealous.
Mind if I ask ya to do the same for me, my prince? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええなぁ
マコトはん。
王子はん、
次はうちも頼んでええやろか……♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
That's way beyond the point here!
Let me down already!
I'll choke you out with my legs if you don't!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやいやいや
そういう問題じゃねぇから！
さっさと降ろせ！
　足で絞めるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text:
You sure are a lively bunch.
I've kind of calmed down thanks to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
にぎやかだな
あんたら。
こっちも少し落ち着いてきたよ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Good to hear we could be of some help.
I'm always so proud of how well our guild members get along.
text_block_list.orig_text:
心の支えになったんやったら
よかったどす。
うちのギルドは、
仲がええのが自慢やからなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
We sure have gotten off track, though.
Would you mind if I ask what that Majimun looks like?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
随分脱線してしもたけど、
その
マジムンいうんは
どんな姿をしてはりますのん？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
We're a li'l bit busy ourselves,
but it ain't Caon's style to ignore those in need.
Any information you could give us would be great.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちらも
今ちょっと大事な用があるんやけど、
【自警団（カォン）】として、
困ってる人は見過ごせへんからなぁ。
教えといてもらえるやろか。

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing.
I happened to catch a glimpse of it floating by.
There's no mistaking it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
俺もさっき偶然、
フワフワと浮かんでるところを見たんだが、
あれは
どう見ても──

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text: It looked exactly like a plushie.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ぬいぐるみの姿をしていたよ。
